messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Very shocked when i saw him alive as i remember his son very upset about it.

output.original_text: Very shocked when i saw him alive as i remember his son very upset about it.
output.joy: I was absolutely thrilled to see him alive, especially remembering how upset his son had been!
output.sadness: I felt a deep sadness, seeing him alive reminded me of how very upset his son was about it.
output.fear: I was terrified to see him alive, recalling how devastated his son was over everything.
output.anger: I was so infuriated to see him alive, especially thinking about how upset his son was because of it.
output.surprise: I was completely blown away to see him alive, especially since I remembered his son being so upset.
output.disgust: I felt a wave of disgust when I saw him alive, knowing how upset his son was about it.
